verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe scheduling (morning PR reviews, overnight CI analysis, weekly dependency audits), trigger-based automation (Slack @mentions producing PRs, GitHub PR auto-review), and long-running/background sessions accessible remotely — directly matching the always-on agent story. However, community reports raise serious reliability concerns for unsupervised autonomous operation (self-verification failures, quality degradation over time, destructive edits like replace_all bugs), suggesting the autonomy works but requires human oversight rather than being fully trustworthy 'maintain and fix autonomously'.
